Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence is the capability of computational systems to perform tasks typically associated with human intelligence such as learning, reasoning, problem-solving, perception, and decision-making. Researchers study both the science and engineering of such systems. [12]

History [edit]

The field of artificial intelligence was founded in 1956 at a workshop held at Dartmouth College. Early researchers were optimistic that thinking machines were only a few years away, and they built programs that could prove theorems and play games.

Later decades brought winters of reduced funding, then a revival as statistical machine learning and large data sets made speech recognition, computer vision, and language models practical. The article also covers ethics, history, and applications in medicine and education.
